name: Uncanny Crystal
summary: Torwa Pathfinder asks you to bring him a damaged blue crystal from the crater. Its strange growths may have an unnatural cause.

sections.title: A Sample for Torwa
sections.body: Torwa Pathfinder wants a closer look at the formations scattered across the crater. While foraging, he spotted a damaged crystal and wonders whether it might reveal where these growths began. You are to bring him a sample if you find it.

sections.title: The Crystal's Marks
sections.body: The crystal has fine cracks and sheds a little powder. Torwa sees lines in it unlike the natural stone beneath the soil. He suspects something made the crystals grow throughout the region, though he cannot tell what.

faq.q: What does Torwa want me to bring?
faq.answer: Torwa Pathfinder asks you to bring him one Damaged Blue Crystal.

faq.q: Where did Torwa see the crystal?
faq.answer: Torwa says he saw a damaged crystal not far from where he was foraging.

faq.q: Why does Torwa want a crystal sample?
faq.answer: Torwa hopes the sample may reveal something about the origins of the unusual crystal growths.

faq.q: What does the crystal look like?
faq.answer: It has delicate cracks, sheds tiny bits of powder, and bears striations unlike the natural stone beneath the soil.

faq.q: What does Torwa think caused the growths?
faq.answer: Torwa suspects something caused the crystals to grow throughout the region, but he does not know what.
